description: This file implements a factory function 'createCommand' that creates and returns different command objects based on the HTTP request method and command name. It references various command classes such as SetState, GetState, GetAppInfo, SetLog, Quit, and Unknown, and includes logic to instantiate the appropriate command object for handling specific requests within the 'rialto::servermanager' namespace.
